title: MacLaren Quest versus the Aprica Laura stroller
label: gear

posts.body:
I am due in Feb and we have been looking at prams and and going a bit bonkers with it all. We definitely want something reclining in case we need to take the baby out during the first 3 months (and I guess it helps for later as well). 

We really liked the Aprica Laura (was roughly about 6 kilos I think) but the MacLaren also looked very efficient for HK MTR/taxi travel. 

Would appreciate feedback for either of the strollers so we can get going on this atleast. Cheers

Kirti
